key_insight: Generative Marketing Mix Modeling (GMMM) extends causal marketing mix analysis to estimate how GEO and GEM in AI-generated answers drive business impact.
engineering_relevance: It gives practitioners a way to quantify and optimize visibility in generative search systems using causal, treatment-sequence-based evidence rather than raw impression counts.
method: Combines repeated generated answers with query volume, platform share, and notice probabilities for GEO.
Uses sponsored-placement records plus notice probabilities for GEM.
Compares expected business responses under alternative treatment sequences to identify causal effects.
evidence_signal: The authors test the method with simulated product-recommendation answers in both English and Japanese to assess empirical performance.
watch_item: Identification depends on sufficient conditions and reliable notice-probability estimates, which may be difficult to measure in real deployments.
paper_title: Generative Marketing Mix Modeling: A Causal Inference Framework Linking GEO and GEM to Business Impact
